blind.description: A messy pile of hardcover books lying scattered and stacked on the floor. The books are rendered in stylized low-to-medium poly geometry with solid, continuous covers and paper block edges. They have reddish-brown, dark green, and tan/leather-bound covers with golden edge highlights and aged yellowish-white pages. Some books are flat, some are tilted or propped up against others. The entire pile rests directly on the floor with no plinth, pedestal, or floating fragments.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a cluster of overlapping rectangular book covers in red, green, and brown, with slight shadows cast to the upper left.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/6 the height of the figure (around 10-12 inches high) and roughly 1/3 as wide as the figure's body (about 1.5 to 2 feet across).
